title: Acquire a hidden field and quadratic defect to count raw Boolean cubics exactly

scientific_scope_status: For raw Boolean cubic p on n=bd bits with radical-free third tensor and centroid field F_(2^d), acquire its field/module coordinates and Frobenius-band quadratic base plus actual polar-rank defect r. For s>=1,2s<d and2r<=d-2s-1, exact counting has bit time2^[r+O(b(log(n+2)+s))]poly(L+n). At s=1 and fixed b this is2^r poly(L+n) with polynomial space. The theorem is independent of the pinned ETH manuscript.
